notes.title: #1 Typos (very small update)
notes.content:
I just started to work on bugs and I released a small update correcting typos. Also have solved the problem, when you first start, players immediately see Russian interface (if you have already launched at least 1 time you will not see a solution to this problem, this information is for others who have never launched this game).
PS: Sorry for bad English.
